title: Recommended! Narration 10/10
text: Use this audio guide because a friend recommended it, and it was very successful!! I didn’t have time to enter, because I didn’t find tickets to the Sagrada Familia for the day I was in Barcelona, and this audio guide was fantastic to do the tour outside the basilica.
author: josebE5162NZ

title: Incredible
text: Visiting the Sagrada Familia and using this app as a guide was a great way to explore this impressive monument. The audio provided detailed information about the history, design and highlights of the structure which further enriched my experience that day, I am pleased with what was provided.
author: josemJ6260CT

title: Excellent app
text:
Very complete information to take the tour of the Sagrada Familia.
It explains every detail of the story very well and is very practical to make the guide without losing any details
author: maub98

title: Self-Guided Audio Tour of Gaudi's Exterior and La Sagrada Familia
text: I had never had this type of experience in which you simultaneously listen to an audio telling a little about history and take a tour while you can observe what is being talked about and I thought it was excellent. Both the detailed information and the voice that guides and makes you feel emotions, immerse you in the story and hook you, which I think is fantastic!
author: vickyvillalara

title: Great SELF GUIDE of the Basilica
text: For those who dont have the time or couldnt go inside the Sagrada Familia, this is the perfect way to understand the story of its creator Gaudi. You will walk around the area surround it, going to take the perfect picture of every angle. It was a very creative way to get to know the story with sound effects.
author: 924desg

title: Unmissable Experience
text: I was impressed by the detail of the history of the Sagrada Familia, its details, meticulous curation of history, even without visiting its interior, we were able to contemplate the majesty of the temple... excellent, looking forward to learning more Soundwalkers experiences...
author: jorgeamoises

title: Awesome
text: It has been a great experience, really. With this construction always half done, Gaudí intended to pay tribute to God. It is the Bible in stone. The artist's brilliant demonstration. Indispensable
author: 426iv_ng

title: Stunning
text: Absolutely stunning building. Can get busy and there will be queues but it’s a must see building. This isn’t a review about Gaudi but this is one of the most outstanding buildings you will ever see. Be sure to see the towers and have a guided tour of you can as you will get much more from your experience. Tour without the towers was €25 in May 2023.
author: MarkMcQuillan

title: The Best in Barcelona!
text: This is amazing!! We were ahle to actually go inside and this is truly genius.  The colors of the stained glass bounces off the walls and looks like the interior is tie dye when the sun hits it. If you get the chance you must see it!
author: debbyr441

title: A must see in Barcelona!
text: This place is unbelievable!!  This is a must see in Barcelona. Make sure you buy your tickets online before and also do a tower tour.
author: Bud56
